privacyPolicy.strongNoteOperatorsStrong: Note for operators: PostyFox is self-hosted software — there is no central "PostyFox" company processing your data. This policy describes what this instance, running the PostyFox platform, collects and does with it. Set the OPERATOR_NAME and OPERATOR_CONTACT environment variables on this deployment to replace the [Operator] and [contact address] placeholders below before publishing.
privacyPolicy.strongAccountIdentityStrong: Account identity. Your username and email address, as provided by the sign-in provider (Keycloak) behind this instance's login page. We do not receive or store your password — authentication is handled entirely by the identity provider and a session cookie issued by the edge proxy.
privacyPolicy.strongConnectorConfigurationCredentials: Connector configuration and credentials. When you connect a platform (e.g. a Discord webhook, a Telegram account, a Bluesky app password, or a paired browser session for FurAffinity), we store the configuration and any tokens, session cookies, or credentials required to post on your behalf. These are held in the platform's secret store and are only ever sent back out to the corresponding third-party platform when delivering your posts.
privacyPolicy.strongPostContentMedia: Post content and media. Text, tags, and any images or files you compose or upload are stored so posts can be generated, delivered, and their status tracked, and so you can review your posting history.
privacyPolicy.strongTemplatesTagPresets: Templates, tag presets, and triggers. Any reusable templates, tag presets, or external-trigger (webhook) configurations you create.
privacyPolicy.strongApiKeysStrong: API keys. If you create an API key for programmatic access, we store a salted hash of the key — never the key itself — so it can be verified but not recovered.
privacyPolicy.strongTechnicalDiagnosticData: Technical and diagnostic data. Basic request telemetry (timing and error traces via OpenTelemetry) generated by your browser session, used only to operate and troubleshoot this instance. This does not include the content of your posts.
privacyPolicy.ifTurnEmShow: If you turn on Show my Gravatar in Settings, the server sends a one-way SHA-256 hash of your email address to Gravatar (operated by Automattic) to fetch your profile picture. Your browser never contacts Gravatar, and nothing is sent unless you opt in. Otherwise, we do not share your data with any other third party.
privacyPolicy.privacyPolicyAppliesPostyfox: This privacy policy applies to this PostyFox instance, operated by
privacyPolicy.weUsOperatorExplains: ("we", "us", "the operator"). It explains what information is collected when you use this instance to compose and deliver posts to third-party platforms (Discord, Telegram, Bluesky, Tumblr, FurAffinity, and Fediverse/ActivityPub servers such as Mastodon), and how that information is stored, used, and protected.
privacyPolicy.informationUsedSolelyOperate: Information is used solely to operate the service you're using, specifically to:
privacyPolicy.authenticateKeepSessionSecure: authenticate you and keep your session secure;
privacyPolicy.renderDeliverPostsPlatforms: render and deliver your posts to the platforms you select;
privacyPolicy.showStatusHistoryPosts: show you the status and history of posts you've submitted;
privacyPolicy.letManageConnectorsTemplates: let you manage connectors, templates, tag presets, triggers, and API keys; and
privacyPolicy.diagnoseFixTechnicalProblems: diagnose and fix technical problems with the service.
privacyPolicy.weDoNotSell: We do not sell your data, and we do not use it for advertising or profiling.
privacyPolicy.postyfoxsPurposeDeliverContent: PostyFox's purpose is to deliver the content you compose to the platforms you connect. When you submit a post, its content and any attached media are sent directly to each selected platform (Discord, Telegram, Bluesky, Tumblr, FurAffinity, or a Fediverse server) using your connected credentials. Once delivered, that content is subject to the destination platform's own privacy policy and terms of service — we recommend reviewing those separately.
privacyPolicy.dataStoredInfrastructureOperated: Data is stored on infrastructure operated by {{ operator }}: structured data (accounts, connectors, posts, templates, triggers) in a PostgreSQL database, uploaded media in S3-compatible object storage, and secrets/credentials in a dedicated secrets store. Some connectors (e.g. Telegram) additionally retain a persistent session on the destination platform's own servers in order to post on your behalf.
privacyPolicy.instanceUsesSingleSession: This instance uses a single session cookie set by the login proxy (oauth2-proxy) to keep you signed in. It contains no tracking identifiers and is not used by any third-party advertising or analytics service.
privacyPolicy.postsTemplatesTagPresets: Posts, templates, tag presets, triggers, connectors, and API keys are retained until you delete them yourself from the relevant page, or until you ask us to remove them. To request deletion of your account and all associated data, contact
privacyPolicy.removingConnectorDeletesIts: . Removing a connector deletes its stored credentials; it does not retract content already delivered to the destination platform.
privacyPolicy.accessInstanceRequiresAuthentication: Access to this instance requires authentication, and API keys are stored only as salted hashes. Reasonable technical and organizational measures are used to protect stored data, but no system can be guaranteed 100% secure. If you believe your credentials have been compromised, disconnect the affected connector and rotate any exposed credentials immediately.
privacyPolicy.serviceNotDirectedChildren: This service is not directed at children and is not intended for use by anyone under the minimum age required to hold an account on the platforms it posts to.
privacyPolicy.weMayUpdatePolicy: We may update this policy as the service changes. Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above.
privacyPolicy.questionsAboutPolicyData: Questions about this policy or your data should be directed to

FurAffinity.blurb: Post submissions and journals to FurAffinity.
FurAffinity.setup: Sign in through PostyFox Connect so your FurAffinity password and session cookies never pass through this page.

X.blurb: Post text and images to X (Twitter).
X.setup: Sign in through PostyFox Connect so your X password never passes through this page. Posts are limited to 280 characters and up to four images.

Toyhouse.blurb: Upload images to your Toyhouse characters.
Toyhouse.setup: Sign in through PostyFox Connect so your Toyhouse password and session cookies never pass through this page.

Kofi.blurb: Post text and gallery posts to your Ko-fi page.
Kofi.setup: Sign in through PostyFox Connect so your Ko-fi password and session cookies never pass through this page. Every post needs a title.

Instagram.blurb: Post to an Instagram Business or Creator account.
Instagram.setup: Connect with Instagram to authorize a Business or Creator account. Every post needs at least one image or video — Instagram has no text-only post type.

Artconomy.blurb: Post submissions and journals to Artconomy.
Artconomy.setup: Sign in through PostyFox Connect so your Artconomy password and session cookies never pass through this page. Image posts need a rating and at least five tags.

SoFurry.blurb: Publish image submissions to your SoFurry account.
SoFurry.setup: Connect with SoFurry to authorize your account. Every post needs a title, a rating and at least one image.
